summary: SilverStripe is a content management system built on top of an underlying Model-View-Controller framework. It provides tools for web authors to manage site content while offering developers a structured architecture to build custom web applications. The software is written in PHP and distributed under a BSD-3-Clause licence.
goodFor: It suits developers who want a PHP-based framework combined with a content management interface for custom website projects.
watchOut: You should verify current community activity and maintenance status, as public repository metrics currently show no recent releases or commit activity.
deployNotes: You will typically need a standard PHP runtime environment paired with a relational database like MySQL or PostgreSQL, alongside a web server such as Nginx or Apache configured to handle URL rewrites.
